evidences.evidence_quote: Low-frequency radio signals have been widely leveraged for fine-grained human activity recognition (HAR), such as Wi-Fi sensing [9, 15, 19, 20, 36, 37], RFID sensing [35, 43], and 4G/5G sensing [7, 40].
evidences.evidence_context: Low-frequency radio signals have been widely leveraged for fine-grained human activity recognition (HAR), such as Wi-Fi sensing [9, 15, 19, 20, 36, 37], RFID sensing [35, 43], and 4G/5G sensing [7, 40]. However, due to their large wavelength as well as their non-coherent sensing approaches, those systems may not be able to detect such subtle eye motions.
